meta.source: Visual language extracted from three reference app screens (colors sampled from pixels, sizes measured at ±2px), then rebranded to Origin per the brand brief: brand yellow #F0FF8A, brand black #000000, logotype in BBH Hegarty. Light theme, status, form, overlay and timer tokens are intentional additions.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background. Light: bright warm beige, never white.

tokens.name: surface-map
tokens.usage: Route map card ground, one step above bg. Map grid lines use surface-control.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Chips, secondary buttons, segmented track, wells. Light: sunken beige.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, inputs, nav: the brightest surface. Light: raised beige.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, pressed and active wells. Light: deeper beige.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Dark: pastel yellow #F0FF8A. Light: indigo #442BEE replaces the yellow entirely on bright screens (fills, primary buttons, progress, selected states). The logo keeps brand-yellow.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: The logo yellow #F0FF8A in both themes. Logo, emblem and brand tiles only. In light mode the UI accent is indigo, not this.

tokens.name: brand-indigo
tokens.usage: Logo indigo #442BEE, the supplied bright logo version (indigo on beige).

tokens.name: brand-beige
tokens.usage: Beige tile behind the bright logo version, as supplied (#FBEECB). Logo tiles only.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label or glyph on a brand fill. Dark: black on yellow. Light: lightest beige on indigo.

tokens.name: sub
tokens.usage: Alias of brand in light mode (#442BEE). Dark: #998AFF is proposed, not decided. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: text-sub
tokens.usage: Sub colour as text or glyph. 5.9:1 to 6.8:1 on the light beige surfaces. Never #442BEE on dark (2.8:1).

tokens.name: on-sub
tokens.usage: Label on a sub fill. Light: lightest beige (or the brand yellow, 6.9:1).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Secondary data hue kept from the reference screens (heart, recovery, progress, completed streak). Fill only; never a status color.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Secondary data hue kept from the reference screens (activity and running). Fill only; never a status color.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Secondary data hue kept from the reference screens (training time). Fill only; never a status color.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Near-black label and icon on a brand, pink, blue or green fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Numerals, values and active nav icon on bg, surface-card, surface-control and surface-raised (11:1 on surface-card).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels and captions on bg and surface-card (5.6:1 on bg, 4.9:1 on surface-card): 'Running', 'Heart Rate', '18/21 DAYS', subtitles, inactive nav icons. Light theme #5c5c5c: 6.9:1 on surface-card, 5.3:1 on surface-control.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: map labels, inactive ruler numbers and ticks. About 3:1 on bg, below the 4.5:1 text floor. Source value kept; never use for information a user must read.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Brand accent as text or glyph. Dark: yellow. Light: indigo.

tokens.name: text-pink
tokens.usage: Pink as text or glyph on bg and cards: accent headline line, required marker, heart icons (6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: text-blue
tokens.usage: Blue as text or glyph on bg and cards (activity icons, info banners; 4.6:1+ on surface-control in light).

tokens.name: text-green
tokens.usage: Green as text or glyph: success messages, completed checks, training-time glyph (5:1+ on surface-control).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and error: error text, invalid input ring, destructive button fill (with on-danger), failed states. Always paired with an icon and words.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Light: beige hairline.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, switch tracks): 3:1+ on bg and surface-card in both themes.

tokens.name: card-edge
tokens.usage: 1px ring around cards. Invisible in dark (source cards have no border), visible in light where a white card sits on an off-white bg.

tokens.name: edge-accent
tokens.usage: Outline on brand fills. Dark: soft yellow. Light: unused now that brand is indigo (edge width is 0), kept near-black.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. Dark: yellow. Light: sub indigo.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Floating pill navigation fill; pair with a 20px backdrop blur. Text on it uses ink and muted.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status text and glyph (expiring soon, caution banners) on bg and cards: 4.9:1+ in both themes. Orange, deliberately far from the brand yellow. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status text and glyph (completed, connected, OK). Alias of text-green.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info status text and glyph (update available, in progress). Alias of text-blue.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error status text and glyph (unavailable video, failed, expired). Alias of danger.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Brand black. App icon, splash and wordmark backgrounds; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: White on black version of the marks and the splash text; the same in both themes.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: The giant goal number. One per screen, in brand.

styles.name: t-headline
styles.usage: Left-aligned screen headline, uppercase, brand. Optional accent line in pink.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Centered screen title, uppercase, brand, with a t-label subtitle under it.

styles.name: t-metric
styles.usage: Value under a metric pill and route stats. Unit in the same style, lowercase.

styles.name: t-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase caption above or below a giant number, in ink.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Upright label under a value, in muted. Title Case.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Section caption and ruler numbers, in muted.

styles.name: t-button
styles.usage: Primary button label, uppercase, on-accent on brand.

styles.name: t-heading
styles.usage: Section, card and sheet titles in ink.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: Body copy and table cells in ink.

styles.name: t-input
styles.usage: Text in inputs; 16px+ so mobile browsers do not zoom.

styles.name: t-button-md
styles.usage: Medium and small button labels, uppercase.

styles.name: t-timer
styles.usage: Timer time on phones (fits 360px). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: t-timer-xl
styles.usage: Timer time in landscape and on large screens.

styles.name: t-wordmark
styles.usage: The ORIGIN logotype only, in capitals, set in BBH Hegarty. Never for UI text; it is Latin-only, so it stays Latin in Arabic layouts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between streak dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stat cards and between pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Value-to-label gap, card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and the content below it.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks on a screen.

tokens.name: dot-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of a streak dot.

tokens.name: control-size
tokens.usage: Round icon button diameter.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Metric pill and primary button height.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large vertical rhythm between screen sections.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on any control.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Coach desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Stat cards, progress tiles, route map card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Metric pills, primary button, tab bar pill, any fully round control.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: Device screen corners in mockups only.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, banners, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: glow-brand
tokens.usage: Soft halo behind the selected ruler tick on the goal dial. Dark theme only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: popovers, menus, dialogs, bottom sheets, dragged row, floating nav.
